citation.authors: Seneschal J, Wolkerstorfer A, Desai SR, et al

record.population: The same 674 patients, pooled post hoc
record.design: Subgroup analysis by age, sex, Fitzpatrick skin type and other traits
record.finding: At week 52, 50.3% of those applying ruxolitinib cream throughout reached the facial score target; responses were seen across subgroups including Fitzpatrick skin type. The abstract gives no numbers for dark skin types.
record.note: Descriptive, post hoc; not a Black-population analysis.

cited_by.title: Vitiligo, spread, starting age and treatment options

record.population: 674 people aged 12 or over with non-segmental vitiligo (two phase 3 trials, TRuE-V1 and V2); how many were Black is not in the abstract
record.design: Post hoc pooled descriptive analysis of two randomised vehicle-controlled trials of 1.5% ruxolitinib cream
record.finding: At week 52, 50.3% (176 of 350) who used the cream throughout reached 75% improvement in facial vitiligo score, against 28.2% (46 of 163) who switched from vehicle cream after week 24. Responses were seen across age, sex and Fitzpatrick skin type, with similar side-effect rates; the abstract gives no figure per skin type.
record.note: Descriptive subgroup analysis, so it does not show the cream works equally in every skin type. Funding not stated in the abstract; funding not checked. The American Academy of Dermatology page acknowledges support from Incyte Dermatology.
